Smart Invert listing copy vs smart-invert engineering — two different jobs

Teams assume Smart Invert compatibility covers storefront language. iOS, UIAccessibility, and Connect actually separate in-app smart inversion handling from product-page copy:

  • Smart Invert on the device — system-wide smart color inversion: UI chrome and interface colors invert while photos, images, and video try to stay looking normal. Toggle under Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size → Smart Invert, or Display Accommodations → Invert Colors → Smart Invert depending on iOS version. System accessibility behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • Smart-invert implementation in the app — UIAccessibilityInvertColors checks, asset variants for smart-inverted displays, ensuring icons and custom UI remain readable when Smart Invert is on, and handling embedded photos or video previews when UI inverts but media should not. Engineering inside the binary — not listing rewrite.
  • Smart Invert marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app respects Smart Invert, uses smart invert colors, or keeps photos natural when the UI inverts. Connect text fields — this page.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China storefront. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Smart Invert support in the app.

A Smart Invert–compatible app and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe smart color inversion on the store page, not whether inverted UI and preserved media render correctly inside the app.

Smart Invert vs Classic Invert, Dark Mode, Color Filters, and Display Accommodations — disambiguation

Apple groups several display-adjustment toggles under Accessibility. Indie teams conflate them on one product page. AppLocale covers Smart Invert and media-aware UI inversion marketing on listing metadata — not the other features:

  • Smart Invert (this page) — inverts UI chrome while leaving photos, images, and video mostly uninverted. Gallery frames may show Settings → Display & Text Size → Smart Invert toggles, UI-inverted / media-preserved comparisons, or "Respects Smart Invert" badges. zh-Hans terms: 智能反转, 智能反色, 智能反转颜色, 反转界面保留媒体.
  • Classic Invert (different) — inverts the entire display including photos, video, and media — 经典反转. Classic Invert is a separate setting with different screenshot framing and buyer vocabulary; do not reuse Smart Invert boilerplate for full-inversion claims. See Classic Invert listing guide.
  • Dark Mode (different) — light and dark UI appearance theme switching — 深色模式. Dark Mode changes appearance palette; Smart Invert flips interface colors while trying to preserve media. See Dark Mode listing guide — appearance themes are not smart-invert copy.
  • Color Filters / Color Tint / Grayscale (different) — tint or grayscale presets under Display Accommodations — 颜色滤镜. Color filters adjust hue or saturation; Smart Invert negates UI colors while preserving media. Do not conflate 颜色滤镜 with 智能反转 on listing copy.
  • Differentiate Without Color (different) — shape-based differentiation preset under Display Accommodations — 不用颜色区分. Not smart color inversion marketing.
  • Display Accommodations hub (different) — umbrella page for color filters, classic invert, smart invert, reduce white point, and related presets. See Display Accommodations listing guide when your English source markets the whole accommodations menu — not when Smart Invert alone is your lead claim.
  • Increase Contrast (different) — stronger UI element borders and fills — 增强对比度. See Increase Contrast listing guide — UI contrast boosts are not smart-invert copy.
  • Reduce Transparency (different) — less blur and frosted glass — 降低透明度. See Reduce Transparency listing guide — opacity changes are not invert-colors copy.
  • On/Off Labels & Button Shapes (different) — switch labels and button outlines under Display & Text Size. See On/Off Labels listing guide — unrelated to smart color inversion.
  • Auto Brightness (different) — automatic display brightness under Display & Brightness — 自动亮度. Separate path from Smart Invert; do not conflate on listing copy.

Your gallery may show a Smart Invert toggle on one frame and a Dark Mode comparison on the next — but listing copy should name each claim accurately per frame. A media-aware inversion demo is not a Classic Invert full-inversion badge, not a Dark Mode theme switch, and not a color-filter picker unless that is what the screenshot shows.

What Smart Invert actually does — listing honesty

Apple ships Smart Invert in iOS and iPadOS Accessibility settings. When enabled, the system inverts interface chrome and UI colors while trying to leave photos, images, and video looking mostly normal — smart color inversion rather than full-screen negation. This differs from Classic Invert, which inverts everything including media. Third-party apps may complement Smart Invert with readable icons, contrast-safe custom UI, or media previews that stay natural when the UI inverts. Smart Invert–specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Media-aware inversion marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Smart Invert — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Smart Invert vs generic "dark mode" or "high contrast"

US pages use "Respects Smart Invert", "Smart invert colors", or "Invert UI while photos stay natural." China storefront copy often uses 智能反转, 智能反色, 智能反转颜色, or 反转界面保留媒体 — depending on whether you mean Apple's Smart Invert setting specifically or general smart-inversion–aware UI. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual scope, not inventing Smart Invert support your app does not ship.

Smart Invert vs Classic Invert — do not conflate

Smart Invert inverts UI chrome but tries to leave photos and video looking normal — 智能反转. Classic Invert inverts the entire display including media — 经典反转. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 经典反转 when your English source only markets media-aware smart inversion. If you support both behaviors accurately, say both; if you support Smart Invert only, keep Classic Invert vocabulary out of subtitle, keywords, and overlays.

Smart Invert vs Dark Mode — do not conflate

Dark Mode switches light and dark appearance themes — 深色模式. Smart Invert negates UI colors while preserving media appearance. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 深色模式 when your English source only shows Smart Invert toggles. See the Dark Mode listing guide only if appearance themes are your lead marketing claim.

Smart Invert vs Color Filters and Grayscale

Color Filters apply tint or grayscale presets under Display Accommodations — 颜色滤镜. Smart Invert flips UI colors while trying to preserve photos. When your gallery only shows Smart Invert toggles, keep color-filter vocabulary out of subtitle and keywords.

Settings path wording across iOS versions

Newer iOS versions surface Smart Invert under Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size → Smart Invert. Some versions nest it under Display Accommodations → Invert Colors → Smart Invert. zh-Hans copy can reference 智能反转 or 智能反色 for the feature name without over-specifying menu depth unless your English gallery shows one path consistently.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need smart-invert search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 智能反转, 智能反色, and 反转界面保留媒体 each signal different intent from Classic Invert, Dark Mode, or Color Filter keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Respects Smart Invert" headlines on gallery frames showing Settings → Accessibility → Smart Invert — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

Smart Invert is under Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size → Smart Invert on newer iOS versions, or Display Accommodations → Invert Colors → Smart Invert on some versions.
